info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Facility By Param1-spec
info.description: The Banking Facilities Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about specific banking facilities based on provided parameters. This endpoint is particularly useful for financial institutions and developers seeking to obtain data related to property portfolios linked to unique identifiers. By querying facilities with the given 'param1', consumers can efficiently integrate facility data into their applications for analysis or reporting. Use cases include portfolio management, risk assessment, and financial planning.

get.summary: Retrieve property portfolio details for a specific facility.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch comprehensive details about the property portfolio associated with a specified facility, identified by its unique ID. It provides relevant data that helps in understanding the characteristics and offerings of the facility's property portfolio.
